sonnet.problem: The story card says 'its fruit will be good... its fruit will be bad.' That points to 'fruit' before card 6 asks how a tree is known, and it rules out the wrong answers (roots, height).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'Son of Man' is the name Jesus uses for Himself. That is a fact from outside this passage, and it has no reference. The docs give Mark 2:10 for it.
sonnet.rule: In the Gospels, he can say "Son of Man" is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).
